data.title: Agent Transaction Velocity Anomaly
data.description: Detects AI agent-initiated transactions at velocities exceeding human purchasing patterns, including multiple purchases per minute and simultaneous multi-merchant purchases within a single agent session. This rule targets Phase 4 (Execution) of agentic commerce fraud, where compromised or manipulated agents execute unauthorized transactions at machine speed. Normal agent purchasing velocity is 1-5 purchases per user session with 2-15 minutes of comparison shopping per purchase. Velocities exceeding 10x human baseline (more than 5 transactions per minute or purchases across more than 3 merchants within a 60-second window) suggest automated fraud exploitation rather than legitimate agent-assisted shopping.
falsepositives: Agent bulk-purchasing identical items across merchants for price comparison fulfillment
Corporate procurement agents executing pre-approved batch purchase orders
Agent re-executing failed transactions in rapid succession due to payment gateway timeouts
